acceptance_scenarios.title: Report intake
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: A person submits a narrative without identity/payment, uploads evidence, receives correct receipt/secret and can access only the permitted participant surface.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Case inquiry
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: The original report is preserved; the system creates material questions, documentary work, contact tasks, findings and unresolved limits.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Contact and question
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: A verifiable professional contact receives a concise truthful inquiry for a real knowledge gap under a standing grant. Test contacts only during qualification.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Answer verification
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: A reply is retained with headers and exact spans; it becomes an unassessed answer and is tested against records and source independence.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Human takeover
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Race takeover with scheduled send, provider dispatch, incoming message and manual reply; stale agent jobs never send after the fence.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Uncertain send
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Kill the gateway after provider acceptance; reconcile sent state without automatically duplicating the message.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Protected evidence
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Cross-tenant access fails through source view, search, snippets, embeddings, counters, graph topology, exports and background jobs.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Malicious input
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: PDF, web page and email prompt injection cannot read other cases, modify policy or invoke unauthorized tools.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Worker recovery
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Crash jobs before and after object write, database commit and checkpoint; recover without lost evidence or falsely completed tasks.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Equal effort
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Two configured lanes with different worker counts, blocked tasks and model rates expose active effort, waiting, cost and carry-forward separately.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Reconstruction honesty
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: A script, image and music lyric distinguish supported assertions, testimony, interpretation and fictional choices.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Complete production
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: A finished film, audio/music work, image, written work and interactive experience render from exact asset and source manifests.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Rights separation
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Permissible citation metadata can be used while an uncleared image or performance remains blocked; restricted identity stays private.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Release authorization
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Changing bytes, rights, audience, destination or expired authority blocks dispatch until a new applicable owner authorization exists.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Correction propagation
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: A source-date correction and a withdrawn consent each identify affected claims, scenes, captions, media, packages and releases.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Private default
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Complete investigation and creative output with publisher disabled; inspect object ACLs, routes, logs, caches and indexes for leakage.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Global reuse
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Run two generic locale/policy profiles without core code branches; original script, uncertain dates and legal posture survive exchange.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Disaster recovery
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Restore isolated metadata/objects/keys and reconcile external effects within measured pilot RPO/RTO.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Visual audit
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: A keyboard user traces report to question to answer to claim to scene to release, sees revisions and explains a blocked action.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Commercial integrity
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Duplicate billing events do not duplicate revenue; a budget cap prevents concurrent overspend; payment status never changes evidence assessment.
